rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Tianyancha provides structured access to Chinese enterprise and business data through 162 MCP tools organized into four layers (L0–L3) covering domains including corporate registry, banking intelligence, investment analysis, legal risk, and supply chain due diligence. The tools map to the Tianyancha API, one of China's leading business data platforms.
